strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Pilih kabeh unduh ing daftar iki (klik maneh kanggo mbusak pilihan)
strings.Remove the selected downloads from the l: Buang unduh sing dipilih saka daftar
strings.Remove finished downloads from the list: Buang unduhan sing rampung saka daftar
strings.Download files from a website section: Ngundhuh berkas saka bagean situs web
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Klik Tambah URL, tempelkeun tautan, lebetkeun kana témbok ieu, atawa unduh tina browser anjeun kalayan ekstensi.

strings.The new language is used after the app r: Basa anyar bakal digunakake sawise aplikasi diwiwiti maneh.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Unduh, video, jeung torrent ngan nganggo adaptor ieu (contona VPN anjeun). Upami éta dipisahkeun, unduhan bakal dieureunkeun tibatan nganggo sambungan séjén.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent blocklist: a file or an https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Torrent teu pernah nyambung ka alamat dina daftar ieu. P2P, DAT, jeung CIDR ogé tiasa dianggo, ogé salaku.gz. Alamat diunduh deui sakali sapoé.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: Alamat blocklist kudu diwiwiti karo https://
Tak bisa nemokake file daftar blok.
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Item anyar tina suplai ieu diunduh nalika judulna cocog sareng aturan: berkas sareng video, sareng torrents nalika torrents diaktifkeun. Aturan nyarankeun kecap anu kedah aya dina judul, atanapi /regular expression/.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Ngundhuh item kang judhulne duwé kabeh tembung iki (kosong = saben item)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Lewati item kang judhulne ngemot salah siji saka tembung iki
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Mung ngundhuh item sing muncul sawise feed ditambahake
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Alamat feed kudu diwiwiti karo http:// utawa https://
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Nalika aku nggunakake komputer, watesan unduh nganti KB/s (0 = ora aktif)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Kecepatan penuh lagi setelah satu menit tanpa input papan ketik atau tetikus.
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Situs kang nyambung liwat (dipisahake nganggo koma, contone example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Potong sacara piawai. Ngagunakeun akun anjeun sorangan; saingan ti situs séjén henteu pernah dikirim ka jasa. Kunci disimpan ku cara dienkripsi sareng henteu pernah disimpen dina salinan cadangan.
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Jumlah unduh: paling akeh MB (0 = ora ana watesan)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: Nalika jumlahna nepi, unduhan dieureunkeun sarta dilanjutkeun ku sorangan nalika periode saterusna dimimitian.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Ngetik alamat web skrip proksi (http:// atawa https://) atawa jalan pinuh ka berkas).
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Alamat proksi (kanggo skrip proksi: alamat web utawa file)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Pasang saben paket ing folder dhewe
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Ngapak arsip pakej nalika kabeh wis rampung
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Tepek teks kalayan tautan, atawa alamat halaman wéb sarta pencét Temukeun Tautan. Bagian tina arsip anu dipisahkeun dikelompokkeun kana hiji paket.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Simpen kabeh galeri nganggo mesin galeri (situs kaya Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; mesin diunduh nalika pisanan)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Muter jendela Tambah ing folder sing dakgunakake pungkasan
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Ngaktifake komputer saka hibernasi kanggo miwiti
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Ngagunakeun timer wake Windows; Pilihan Daya kudu ngamungkinkeun timer wake. Aplikasi kudu jalan (bisa di dulang).
strings.Converting needs FFmpeg. MP3 uses the be: Konversi butuh FFmpeg. MP3 nganggo kualitas variabel pangluhurna; FLAC nyimpen sagala rincian sora anu dikirim ku situs.
strings.Downloads I resume myself: run this many: Unduh aku terusake dhewe: lakuake akeh iki bebarengan ing sisih gulungan (0 = padha ngenteni slot gulungan)
strings.When the app starts, remove finished dow: Nalika aplikasi diwiwiti, mbusak unduh sing wis rampung sing filene wis dipateni utawa dipindahake
strings.Settings, the download list and unfinish: Pangaturan, daftar ngundhuh lan bagean sing durung rampung disimpen ing
strings.The data moves the next time the app sta: Data dipindahkeun nalika aplikasi dimimitian deui. Sadayana disalinan sarta dicek saméméh salinan lami dileungitkeun.
Data wis ana ing direktori iki.
strings.Choose a folder that is not inside the c: Pilih folder anu teu aya dina folder data ayeuna (atawa sebalikna).
strings.Put a range in square brackets: [001-100: Lebetkeun hiji jurang dina kurung: [001-100] nyimpen tilu digit, [1-100] henteu, [a-z] ngagunakeun huruf sarta [0-100:5] ngitung dina limaan. Saran dina kurung, {jpg,png}, coba unggal. Sajumlah jurang dikalikeun.
strings.Words find links that contain them; * an: Kata-kata bakal nemokake tautan sing ngemot tembung-tembung mau; * lan? ya iku aksara-aksara gantian;! sing diwiwiti bakal ninggalake tautan. Conto: *.jpg!*thumb*

strings.Paste one link to a profile, channel, pl: Lebetkeun hiji tautan ka profil, saluran, playlist, galeri atawa halaman dina situs mana wae anu didukung ku mesin video. Nexonic bakal manggihan unggal video anu dibuka ka saha wae (tanpa kudu ngadaptar), leumpang kana anu geus anjeun gaduh sarta ngundeur nu sejenna ka gulunganna sorangan.
